mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, we have clear skies at Verona Area High School with a temperature of 52 degrees. The overnight low will drop to 45 degrees with no rain in the forecast, and we are under a third quarter moon tonight.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month, honoring the expertise of our local planners. Additionally, please note that a section of Highway M will be closed for construction from October 6 through October 9, so plan for detours.
There is a lot to do this weekend, including the Farley Center Fall Festival and the World Dairy Expo happening today. Also, look forward to Trivia at the Hop Haus Brewing Company on Tuesday.
On September 21, officers handled a retail theft report in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue where a suspect was identified stealing candy and subsequently cited.

Today's flavor was OREO Cookie Cheesecake. As the store is currently closed for the night, we invite you to come back tomorrow morning when we open at 10:00 AM to enjoy our next flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
